description: Forge port of Accurate Block Placement Reborn. 1.20.1 on master, 1.12.2 backport on the 1.12.2 branch.

mods.name: Accurate Block Placement
mods.description: Build at super speed with your bare hands! Hold right-click to place blocks rapidly without double-placing on the same spot.

releases.notes:
## New
- Marked as client-side: a player with the mod can join a server that does not have it.

## Fixed
- Dedicated server crash on startup, reported by Darkikos on CurseForge
- Blocks were placed while a screen was open, reported by @lordPhantom397 (#1)
- With a raycast mod installed, right-clicking a non-collidable block such as an open fence gate did nothing, reported by @soloseul (#2)

## Fixed
- The game crashed at startup alongside MixinBooter 10
- Blocks were not placed with Potion Core installed
- Blocks were placed while a GUI was open, reported by @lordPhantom397 (#1)
- The key binding and the mode toggle message showed raw translation keys, reported by @lordPhantom397 (#1)
- With a raycast mod installed, right-clicking a non-collidable block such as an open fence gate did nothing, reported by @soloseul (#2)

1.12.2 backport of Accurate Block Placement, based on the 1.20.1 Forge port.

Hold your use key and look at a new block — it will automatically place it no matter how fast you move. No more missed placements or double-placing on the same spot.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.12.2 + Forge 14.23.5.x
- [MixinBooter](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mixin-booter) 9.0+

Client-side only — no server installation required.

## Installation

Drop the jar and MixinBooter into your `mods` folder.
